message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data sources are local filesystem paths; no remote fetching is performed and no checksum or integrity verification is implemented.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels from a CSV and converts them to float arrays but performs no validation against an expected label set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset preparation only filters for valid image extensions and non-empty folders; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering mechanisms.

No detected model integrity verification: The code calls build_model with pretrained=args.pretrained but there is no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source enforcement on the loaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads labels and filters by fold but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch optimizers and Apex AMP for mixed precision; no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack construction anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a fold-based train/eval split is used, there is no held-out test set isolated from the training loop, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple fully independent metric sources to guard against manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads images from disk via PlanetDataset without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation are visible in the inference data-flow path shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-classification model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
